# Native bundle launcher

Unmodified main-universal2 from py2app0.28.10 wheel:
https://files.pythonhosted.org/packages/be/d8/a04a88b182613370a262f674929f0e284ea04e1803f2d38fc5639fbec2d7/py2app-0.28.10-py3-none-any.whl

Includes x86_64 and arm64. Loads existing host Python framework in-process; no installer/compiler. MIT license retained as LICENSE.txt. Source main.c in that wheel documents PyRuntimeLocations, PyExecutableName and PyMainFileNames. This is not a bundled Python runtime or independent application security audit.
